sportworld.linkLead: Mock sports server with simulated match data for the AI newsroom agent
sportworld.title: SportWorld API
sportworld.lead: Mock sports server standing in for a paid deep-data feed. Each generated match keeps a real finished fixture's final and half-time score from football-data.org; line-ups, scorers, events and stats are simulated from the clubs' squads.

generate.description: Takes the newest finished fixtures of the competition that have not been simulated yet.

list.description: Newest first. Use since to poll for matches generated after a time.

one.description: The full match: info, key events, line-ups, stats and the event list, in the structure of the bundled demo match.

remove.description: The fixture can then be simulated again (same result, same details).

agent.title: AI match posts
agent.lead: The newsroom agent turns new SportWorld matches into AI match posts: a checked story from the match facts, plus trusted publishers' coverage of the fixture as attributed links. Posts wait here for review; readers see nothing until the newsroom approves. The cron checks every 5 minutes and runs the agent when the interval below has passed.
agent.noKey: No OpenAI key on this server: posts use the facts as they are (template) instead of an AI-written story.
agent.nothing: No new SportWorld matches to write about.
agent.waiting: SportWorld match waiting for a post | SportWorld matches waiting for a post
agent.empty: No posts yet. Generate matches in SportWorld, then press Run now.
